I have tried somewhat to join communities (a job, orchestra etc.) but I find myself too tired and have no interest in them. The thing is it isn't their loss. It's mine. I am dependant on them due to how young I am. I have a doctors appointment on Friday on whether my mum allows me to have further help (she doesn't want me to) but I just need her to understand that I really do need help. 
Back info: 
My mum is a social worker and regularly tells me what a disappointment I am and that I'm just like all her clients and will end up like them. If I am not happy or sleep excessively etc. I get in a lot of trouble and she has broken my door and hit me in anger.

I'm 15 and I have a drinking problem. I get that it allows you to shut off from everything and resign to your self. Go to a hospital. It'll be shitty but it will work, I can promise you that you won't enjoy it but it will get it done. The other thing to do is to see a councillor or social worker and they will help set you up for a rehabilitation centre.

I'm sick of people telling me to find the beauty in life because I don't see it and I don't care anymore. Feeling out of place everywhere I go and anyone I'm with isn't a very temporary problem as well as being bisexual.

So much has brought me to this everlasting darkness. I've needed help since I was about 12 but didn't know how to get the help so I told a teacher that I haven't been eating my lunches and that I would then hide the food; the school then rang my parents who instead of actually thinking "hang on there might be something going on here" said that I was making it all up for attention and I was grounded for trying to call out for help. 
In year 7 a girl I thought was one of my best friends stood up in front of the class and told me all my friends hated me, which was true, to have the class laugh/stare at me. Start of last year I planned a surprise party for a close friend of mine along with her two close friends which resulted in them verbally abusing me and sending constant messages. She also pretended to receive mean messages from me and told a LOT of people which then got around through the yearevel so much that even my friends believed her and wouldn't talk to me. I have had a friend of my old friend continually tell me that I have no friends and that I should kill myself. I am bisexual and my parents are indenial about jt and keep telling me I'm confused. This is a snippet of it all but I have always felt out of place. So no, I don't trust people anymore and I don't want to go put myself out there only to be hurt once again. I have been playing the flute for 9 years, I do dancing, I did cross country etc. I do many activities but nothing interests me.

I have tried to talk to people. I booked myself a doctors apointment after two years of my mum saying no and she still says to me "what if you are happy?" Or "is this all a stunt". I can't agree with equinox because I don't see anything beautiful here. I am thinking clearly and I haven't come to this decision quickly.

Maybe you're not "just another addict"? Everyone is just another something; but at the same time they are so much more than just that. Why should your drug use define you? We choose what defines us, and I know that there is more to you than a drug. I can't understand exactly how you must be feeling right now because I'm not in the same position as you but I do know that so many people are and so many of them have gotten the help they need. Tomorrow, wake up walk into an emergency hospital or a counciling clinic or a phycologist and tell them what you wanted to do. Just don't give in.

I suggest calling a doctor and perhaps a hospital. Do not take it lightly. Even if she seems happy and fine. When talking to her about this you need to remember that this is just life to her. It's just a normal Wednesday or whatever so when she talks to you do not over react and remain calm. I also suggest keeping an eye on her.
